title: Nell and the Best Spot
note: b418 — Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new graphemes ore, oor, our.

pages.brief: Nell the bee hovering above a patch of grey gravel path lit up by a bright shaft of sunlight.
Pip the sparrow hopping towards the bright patch of sunlight on the gravel path, looking at it keenly.
Moss the hedgehog shuffling towards the same bright patch of sunlight on the gravel path.
Fig the caterpillar crawling slowly towards the bright patch of sunlight, antennae raised.
Nell the bee, Pip the sparrow, Moss the hedgehog and Fig the caterpillar all gathered close at the edge of one small sunny spot on the gravel path.
Nell the bee hovering in front of Pip, Moss and Fig, one leg raised as if explaining a plan.
Nell the bee lining up Pip, Moss and Fig in a row beside the sunny spot on the gravel path, each waiting their turn.
Pip the sparrow sitting in the sunny spot on the gravel path while Moss the hedgehog waits just behind him.
Fig the caterpillar resting happily in the sunny spot on the gravel path, stretched out.
Nell the bee settling into the sunny spot on the gravel path, wings relaxed, looking pleased.
